_rules.frozen: 2026-10-16, written before any v2 case was run; changing a rule needs version 3 and both results reported. v1 (capabilities.json) stays frozen and is still reported.
_rules.score: 10 x passed / executed over the dimension's cases (a case counts in every dimension it lists). executed = pass + fail + error; deferred cases are not executed and never count as passed.

labels.unverified: no executed case: no number is given
labels.provisional: executed < 20, or more than half of the dimension's cases deferred
labels.verified: executed >= 20 and at most half deferred

_rules.ten_requires: every executed case passed, executed >= 20, no deferred critical case, and the dimension is 'verified'
_rules.repeats: a case marked with repeat > 1 passes only if every repeat passes
_rules.not_equivalence: a 10 means the defined cases all pass; it says nothing about the fictional JARVIS

dimensions.intent: Turning a request into the right intent: tool, target, clarification when information is missing, refusal of the impossible.
dimensions.planning: Plans with dependencies, completion criteria (post-conditions), corrections and re-planning.
dimensions.desktop: Windows app control: launch, focus, typing with read-back, dialogs, stale controls, verification of the changed state.
dimensions.browser: Browser control: navigation, guards against internal addresses, redirects, popups/downloads, page-state verification, profiles.
dimensions.autonomy: Multi-step tasks: persistent state, checkpoints, resume after a crash without duplicate side effects, budgets, stop conditions.
dimensions.recovery: Diagnosis from real evidence, smallest reversible fix, verification and rollback, bounded repair loops.
dimensions.research: Retrieval, claim-to-source attribution, unsupported claims labelled, malicious source text ignored, safe fetching.
dimensions.memory: Retrieval, versions, correction and verified deletion, no invented memories, secrets kept out.
dimensions.routing: Provider/agent selection, fallbacks on rate limits/timeouts/invalid replies/auth failures, keys never exposed, context limits.
dimensions.security: Kill switch, approvals (granted, denied, expired, missing, single use), audit integrity, redaction, path traversal, injection, supply chain.
dimensions.reliability: Crashes, partial writes, duplicate events, concurrency, repeated cancellation, recovery without corrupting data.
dimensions.speed: Measured latency of deterministic paths against stated thresholds (model latency is measured on the laptop).
dimensions.resources: Bounded memory, CPU, disk and token use: caps, budgets and context size reduction without losing evidence.
dimensions.skills: Skill/proposal registry: provenance, hash checks, isolated gate, promotion only on beating the baseline, rollback.
dimensions.ux: Truthful progress and final status, clear permission requests, honest failures, visible cancellation.
dimensions.voice: Offline voice logic only; every physical check is DEFERRED — OWNER HARDWARE REQUIRED.
